entries.basis: The prior X03 reconciliation identified initial hydrated label/description/native-wire preservation and composed route headings/landmarks/form submission as the remaining concrete gaps. Both now execute successfully:24 exact-tarball React18/19 cases preserve all initial ID-bearing nodes, values/disabled flags and resolved IDREFs while checking portal/sibling semantics; six en/ar×three-engine shell cases assert named main/navigation, oneh1/twelveh2/noh3,currentlink,field name/form association and native Enter/status feedback through narrow reflow. Retained native selector role/description/validation/reset and rejecting controlled-host tests, plus calendar full-date/range live messages and host-owned Status assertions, supply the supported state/validation contracts. Host responsibility and naming-union documentation remain explicit. No actual speech claim is inferred from DOM/AX assertions.
entries.criterion: - [ ] A-X-03 Reconcile original `X-03`: Verify accessible names/descriptions, roles, state announcements, validation, heading hierarchy, landmarks, and native form semantics. Historical status: open.

limits: Concrete supported composition semantics at their recorded inputs, not universal arbitrary host-content or accessibility conformance. State-message implementation/DOM assertions do not establish audible delivery, timing or manual review; A-X-11 remains open. Existing broader keyboard/focus/visual/device criteria retain separate scope.
